Hmm. But wait — is the root cause a DNS failure (service_dns_resolution_failure) on ts-security-service? Or is the tsdb-mysql-leader service missing/misconfigured? Note the service list includes "tsdb-mysql-leader" and "tsdb-mysql-follower" as allowed connectivity targets. Note tsdb-mysql-0/1/2 are pods (statefulset). The statefulset is named tsdb-mysql; services tsdb-mysql-leader / tsdb-mysql-follower may exist as headless/leader services.

Also note the istio-proxy logs show DNS lookups to istiod failing (10.255.16.254:53 i/o timeout) — but those timestamps are 2026-03-16T19:5x, whereas the snapshot "now" is ~2026-03-17T04:0x. Interesting: the istio-proxy DNS failures are at 19:5x on 3/16 (8 hours earlier) — hmm, actually the pod start time is Tue, 17 Mar 2026 03:56:35 +0800 = 2026-03-16T19:56:35Z. So those istio logs are the same wall clock (UTC). So the istio-proxy logs at 19:59–20:03 UTC = 03:59–04:03 +0800, current. So the istio-proxy IS having DNS resolution failures to istiod.istio-system.svc, i/o timeout on 10.255.16.254:53.

Hmm, so DNS resolution is failing in this pod. But is that a cluster-wide DNS problem or specific? Other pods are running fine (2/2 Running, ready). So other pods can resolve. Wait, but the istio-proxy DNS failure to istiod... Many other pods presumably started at the same time (5m ago) and are fine.

Hmm, the whole namespace was restarted 5 minutes ago. All pods are ~5m old. So this is a fresh scenario deployment. ts-security-service fails due to UnknownHostException on tsdb-mysql-leader.

Key question: is the root cause `service_dns_resolution_failure` (APP target) or `mysql_invalid_port`/`mysql_invalid_credentials` or a missing/mismatched service name (service_env_var_address_mismatch)? The error is name resolution failure for tsdb-mysql-leader.

Also check another service that uses the same DB (e.g., ts-order-service uses tsdb-mysql-leader too? Actually most train-ticket services use tsdb-mysql). ts-security-service is the only one crashing, so maybe its env var address is wrong.

Let's check GetAppYAML(ts-security-service) and the secret ts-security-mysql, plus services list to see if tsdb-mysql-leader exists.

Good differentiator: if the service tsdb-mysql-leader is missing → its a missing service (but there's no "missing service" root cause option... there's service_selector_mismatch, service_env_var_address_mismatch, service_dns_resolution_failure). If tsdb-mysql-leader exists and is resolvable from other pods but not this pod → service_dns_resolution_failure on ts-security-service... Hmm, but actually the flaky part: DNS failures also affect the istio-proxy in the same pod (istiod lookup).
